INSTRUCTIONS: 2. Fill in sensor, target, terrain, tracker references
SENSORS: paths relative to config/sensors/. One file per sensor.
TARGETS: path relative to config/targets/. Defines target behaviors + duration.
TERRAIN: path relative to config/terrain/. Defines environment + terrain type.
TRACKERS: paths relative to config/trackers/<TYPE>/. Algorithm-specific tuning only.
Shared tracker params (volume, beta, Pd, filter) live in config/trackers/tracker_globals.json
CACHE: use_cached_detections=true skips detection generation (faster tracker tuning).
Only need to regenerate when sensors/targets/terrain change.
DEGRADATION: Weather effects. enabled=true activates rain.
PLATFORMS: Only for moving sensor platforms (aircraft, ship). Leave empty {} for ground radar.
